==Experience rates/profit at level 99==
Players may earn more experience (and its respective profit) with the felling axe/rations, Forestry/Lumberjack outfit, and other experience-boosting items.

'''Note:''' The profit per hour for some logs is interpolated, and as such, may only be used as an approximation.

|[[Camphor tree]]s are found on [[The Great Conch]], requiring 45 [[Sailing]] and partial completion of [[Troubled Tortugans]] to access. There are trees west of [[The Summer Shore]] that are relatively close to a bank. They can be chopped at the [[Sacred Grove]] after completion of [[The Red Reef]], which has a deposit box and an altar.  They can also be grown in a [[hardwood tree patch]].

Players should use a [[dragon axe]] on these trees.
